name: mdgraph
description: Durable memory for a repository: one markdown file per finding, on its own git branch, read and written through one CLI.

interface.longDescription: One markdown file per finding, linked by name, kept on a dedicated mdgraph git branch. Hooks print the rules at session start and hold the first write until the session reads the index.
defaultPrompt: Record what we found in the mdgraph.
Check the mdgraph for broken entries.
